VERDICT: Do not change execution logic; add log-only instrumentation in maker_policy.py, exit_policy.py, and supervisor.py to quantify adverse selection, maker-vs-taker P&L delta, and early-exit edge destruction before any tuning.

REASONING: With 1 ARMED + 6 PROBATION nodes the sample is too small to justify threshold changes; the three flagged questions are all answerable from diagnostics alone. Every measurement can be computed at fill/exit time using data already in scope (mid at quote, mid at fill, counterfactual taker price, model edge at entry vs exit), satisfying DRY_RUN=1 / PLACE_REAL_ORDERS=0 constraints.

NEXT_STEPS:
1. maker_policy.py — in the fill handler (e.g., on_maker_fill / process_fill): log `adverse_sel_bps = (mid_at_fill_plus_30s - fill_px) * side_sign * 1e4 / mid`; sample mid via existing market-data cache at fill and schedule a +30s mark.
2. maker_policy.py — at quote placement (build_quote / compute_maker_price): log `quote_edge_bps` (model fair vs quote px) and `counterfactual_taker_px` (current best ask/bid) so realized maker P&L can be diffed against taker in post-hoc analysis; emit both in one structured log line keyed by order_id.
3. exit_policy.py — in evaluate_exit / should_exit: log `theoretical_edge_remaining = model_fair - position_cost_basis` alongside `exit_reason` and realized P&L; aggregate per exit_reason so edge-destruction ratio = realized/theoretical is computable offline.
4. supervisor.py — in the fill/exit event loop (handle_fill / reconcile_positions): add a single DiagnosticRecord writer (order_id, node_id, tree state ARMED/PROBATION, timestamps, fields from steps 1–3) to a dedicated diagnostics log, gated behind a config flag defaulting on in DRY_RUN.
5. Add a pure analysis script (scripts/analyze_execution.py) that parses the diagnostic log and reports: mean adverse selection by node, maker-vs-taker P&L delta, and early-exit edge-destruction %; no changes to live code paths.

CALL_BACK_IF: Re-enter for tuning only after ≥30 maker fills and ≥20 exits per node show (a) adverse selection consistently >2 bps against maker quotes, (b) maker underperforms taker counterfactual net of fees, or (c) early exits realize <50% of theoretical edge — and only then propose parameter changes, still under DRY_RUN=1.
